Ganddal Pikekor INTERNATIONALLY FAMOUS GIRLS CHOIR
Audun Vagle (back), the 33 year old director and founder of
the Pikekor, is a high school music instructor and the organist
in sha Hauland Church in Sandnes.
He has gained fame for his
work with choirs in Norway and abroad. Three of his six choirs
were among the ten finalists in a Norwegian national music
contest

The Ganddal Pikekor (pronounced Pee'-keh-kor -
Translates:
Girls Choir) is a community choir since
it is made up of girls from not only the village of
Gandal but from surrounding Sandnes Township as
well.
Originally the Pikekor consisted of less than 20
school girls around twelve years of age.
Today there
are six choirs in all totaling over 350 girls.
From this
large group the best singers are chosen, forming the
smaller choir pictured on the album cover.
Most of
these girls are about 18 to 20 years of age and have
been singing in the Pikekor for as many as eight years.
